# Aegis Overseas Education Services

> Aegis Overseas Education Services Pvt. Ltd. is a premier study abroad education consultancy headquartered in South India (with operations across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and the United Kingdom), providing ethical, student-centered counseling, university admissions, scholarship assistance, and visa processing for top global destinations.

Aegis Overseas guides students and families to top-ranked universities in the United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland, and New Zealand.

## Key Services
- [Study Abroad Counselling](https://aegisoverseas.com/services/counselling): Personalized academic profile evaluation, career roadmap, and country selection.
- [University Shortlisting](https://aegisoverseas.com/services/university-selection): Data-driven shortlisting across 5,000+ universities worldwide.
- [Application & SOP Guidance](https://aegisoverseas.com/services/application-assistance): Comprehensive statement of purpose editing and application submission.
- [Scholarship Assistance](https://aegisoverseas.com/scholarships): Guidance on merit, government (Chevening, Fulbright, DAAD), and university fee waivers.
- [Education Loan Support](https://aegisoverseas.com/services/education-loans): Collateral and non-collateral loan sanctions through banking partners.
- [Visa Defense & Processing](https://aegisoverseas.com/services/visa-assistance): Mock interviews, financial documentation checks, and filing support.
- [Accommodation & Airport Pickup](https://aegisoverseas.com/services/accommodation): Safe student housing placement and pre-departure briefings.

## Study Destinations
- [Study in the UK](https://aegisoverseas.com/destinations/uk): 1-year master's degrees, Russell Group universities, and 2-year Graduate Route work visa.
- [Study in the USA](https://aegisoverseas.com/destinations/usa): STEM OPT 3-year work extension, Tier-1 research universities, and F-1 visa preparation.
- [Study in Canada](https://aegisoverseas.com/destinations/canada): DLI institutions, SDS visa stream, and up to 3-year PGWP pathways.
- [Study in Australia](https://aegisoverseas.com/destinations/australia): Group of Eight institutions, CRICOS programs, and post-study work rights.
- [Study in Germany](https://aegisoverseas.com/destinations/germany): Zero-tuition public universities, APS verification, and 18-month job seeker visa.
- [Study in Ireland](https://aegisoverseas.com/destinations/ireland): Dublin Silicon Docks tech hub, 1-year master's programs, and 2-year Stamp 1G visa.
- [Study in New Zealand](https://aegisoverseas.com/destinations/new-zealand): Globally recognized universities with Green List occupational pathways.
- [Study in Europe](https://aegisoverseas.com/destinations/europe): English-medium programs in France, Netherlands, Sweden, and Italy.
